rule: Nothing in this plan has run. Every artifact hash, result and verdict is null until a run records it. Pass criteria come from TECH-CORE-RETRIEVAL-CODE-001 v1.0; this plan does not restate or invent thresholds.

fixed_repository_facts.normalization: core_l2_unit_v1, unit-norm tolerance 1e-6, validated never repaired
fixed_repository_facts.representation: float32 little-endian, metric cosine or dot
fixed_repository_facts.q1_synthetic_campaign: qualification/semantic_index/q1/README.md (768 dimensions, k in {1,10,50}, at most 10,000 active records; noncanonical synthetic)

runs.name: Real embedding profile and execution qualification
preconditions: A SemanticEmbedder implementation outside this repository's model-free code, approved for install
Declared SemanticEmbeddingProfile and ExecutionProvenance with an explicit CompatibilityDecision
evidence_to_collect: profile digest, execution digest, representation digest, generation digest
model artifact identity and hashes as recorded by the run
every produced vector accepted by encode_vector with no renormalization
query-time decide_compatibility outcome against the index execution

runs.name: Exact backend parity and scale
preconditions: QP-01 profile available or the q1 synthetic campaign generated
evidence_to_collect: rank_semantic output equal to the q1 oracle over the full campaign frontier for each k
full-frontier scoring confirmed before retention at frontier sizes above the 200 lane budget
latency and memory measurements at the specification's declared scale

runs.name: Content-bearing canonical input
preconditions: A canonical-input version that composes stored content, replacing the identity-surface-only input
evidence_to_collect: new canonical_input_version identifier and its input digests
rebuild and activation under the new profile, old generation refused as incompatible

runs.name: Python and TypeScript code-analysis producers
preconditions: Use the existing graph/governance authority selected by TECH-CORE-RETRIEVAL-CODE-001 decisions D19-D20
Bind candidate import and snapshot activation to the existing runtime owner before implementation
evidence_to_collect: producer build identities and parser versions
VerifiedCodeAnalysisBatch bound to one sealed snapshot with exact file digests
fail-closed behaviour for unresolved or mixed-resolution edges on real repositories

runs.name: Transport and client exposure
preconditions: A contract decision for a public hybrid mode on an existing or new operation
evidence_to_collect: wire shape for lane status and reasons
parity between in-process and transport results for each mode
partial and unavailable statuses visible to clients without lexical substitution

runs.name: Packaging, required CI rows and release
preconditions: QP-01 through QP-05 as the specification requires
evidence_to_collect: Core acceptance and the three Phase 2 platform rows green on the pull request
